ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2024-09-28..2025-10-03) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-10-03..2026-07-03
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-10-03..2026-07-03
notes: dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (189 days between 2025-06-27 and 2026-01-02) — FY2025 DPS 0.42 + the quarters since (2026-01-02: 0.12, 2026-04-03: 0.12, 2026-07-03: 0.12) − the same quarters a year earlier (2024-12-27: 0.105, 2025-03-28: 0.105, 2025-06-27: 0.105)
